resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives 30N-10E-15; the 2010 Forest Service list gives T32N, R12E Sect. 21. The story uses only the distance and direction from Moose Creek, which both sources agree on, and the record's coordinates were not checked against either legal description.

sources.title: Moose Creek, One Uniform One, the Grass Strip Deep in the Selway

notes_for_editor: Built 1929 and destroyed about 1949 agree across all four pages. No page describes what remains at the site, so the story says so. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page carries a photo of the cabin credited to the Fire Lookout Museum, which is already in the record. The Forest Service list (2010) and the Forest Lookouts page both draw on Ray Kresek. The two township and range values disagree (see resolved_conflicts). The brief's two_story kind and county are correct. The Radio Hangar blog (source 5) is a secondary aviation source used only for background on the Moose Creek Ranger Station; the Forest Service station page was not read.
